KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   B. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. fupi
   C. pana
   D. zito

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

6. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

7. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Anga.

8. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. watoto
   C. mitoto
   D. kitoto

9. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Huyo na Hao and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
